response.justification: The candidate lacks direct experience with C++ or Rust in geospatial routing pipelines, despite extensive full-stack and web-focused work; their GIS work is open-source and non-commercial, with no evidence of routing tile optimization, real-time traffic integration, or low-latency distributed systems required for the role.
strengths: Strong open-source contributions in GIS and data platforms
Proven ability to work across diverse tech stacks and languages
Experience with Linux, distributed systems, and performance-critical applications
concerns: No demonstrated commercial C++ or Rust experience in routing or geospatial pipelines
Lack of evidence in fault-tolerant data pipeline design or navigation system QA
Primary tools (TypeScript, DLang, Node.js) mismatch core requirement of C++ for routing tiles
